# Runtime dependencies of the pipeline (pyproject.toml), pinned with the sha256 hashes of their published files.
# The weekly refresh, the deploy and CI install exactly these with `pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt`,
# so that an unattended run, which holds a token that can push to main, installs only the files CI has tested.
# pyproject.toml keeps the version ranges. Dependabot proposes updates of these pins (.github/dependabot.yml), and CI
# runs on them before they reach main. To regenerate for Python 3.12, as the workflows use (uv or pip-tools):
#    uv pip compile pyproject.toml --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes -o requirements.txt
